name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

eligibility.other_conditions: Individual/Joint owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, and SHGs of farmers including animal husbandry and fisheries.

benefits: Short-term institutional crop loan and working capital credit up to Rs. 3 Lakhs at a concessional interest rate of 7%, further subsidized down to 4% upon prompt timely repayment (Interest Subvention Scheme). Includes RuPay debit card and personal accident insurance.
documents_required: Land ownership record (RoR/Khasra/Khatauni) or lease agreement
Bank Account details with no prior default certificate
application_process: Fill simplified 1-page KCC application form at nearest commercial, regional rural, or cooperative bank branch.
Branch verifies land records and issues sanction within 14 working days under simplified RBI norms.
Receive RuPay KCC card for ATM withdrawals and POS purchases of agricultural inputs.
statutory_citation: RBI Master Circular FIDD.CO.FSD.BC.No.6/05.05.010/2022-23 (Kisan Credit Card Scheme)
